description: Signed Go binary released through netCI to a systemd unit: install, restart, health check, promote and roll back by symlink.

assertions.assertion: the netCI API is healthy
v0.1.0: the build produced a sha256 content digest
v0.1.0: Syft produced a CycloneDX SBOM
v0.1.0: no fixable critical vulnerabilities
v0.1.0: no fixable high vulnerabilities
v0.1.0: Cosign verifies the built binary
v0.2.0: the build produced a sha256 content digest
v0.2.0: Syft produced a CycloneDX SBOM
v0.2.0: no fixable critical vulnerabilities
v0.2.0: no fixable high vulnerabilities
v0.2.0: Cosign verifies the built binary
two versions of the binary have different content digests
the systemd template selects the binary stage list, not the container one
the signed binary satisfies the supply-chain policy
production waits for approval
the systemd service reports healthy
the current symlink points at the released version
the installed binary is byte-identical to the approved artifact
the symlink moved to the promoted release
netCI records the rollback
the symlink is back on the previous release
the rolled-back service is healthy
systemd reports the unit as active
